title: Active ToR Link Down Test Cases
author: theasianpianist
body:
Test all packet flow scenarios after link between the active ToR and fanout goes down.

Depends on #2758, #2759, #2756

comments.author: theasianpianist
comments.body: Putting on hold for now, since there is not a good way to blackhole heartbeat traffic

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Test link down scenarios for dual ToR

#### How did you do it?

For each traffic scenario (upstream, downstream to active, downstream to standby):
- Take down the active ToR fanout link to server
- Take down the standby ToR fanout link to server
